This is my first post on the forum and it is done in one of the many valuable threads here on RTM. After being a member for some time, I have been studying all the material available. I did not post before for which I apologize, however, my reason for not posting was to find out myself if the material on RTM really works and for me the more important why it works. I do not take things for granted but want to understand why things work or don't, maybe its something in my nature to be skeptical and eager to know the why, who, how etc. Sorry for drifting away, back on topic. I would like to say to you Warren, please keep up posting your valuable insights on the markets so the beginners have some sort of reference point they can use in their own journey on understanding the markets. At least, this is how I think about, have done and still doing it. I value threads like yours and that of other members here on RTM as the nuggets which new traders should read, study, learn and take from what works for them to reach to the final gold bar.

Anyways am I too late to say a Big shout out from Mr.B?
Thanks man, i enjoy your posts

I have been nagged by Springer!

" Warren Post some charts"

2 guys to thank today...................Aaron, you were a good wingman. (His screen was bigger than my screen...........at the time) Thanks for looking into the news times.

And IF, for highlighting what i would of seen if i had another 20 inches

All,

As you can see i have been about 20 inches to short today!

My Son, curious as he is noted this pattern, so we took a picture of it. Welcome to my Sat-Nav

The conversation after went a little like this;

Warren: These pattern's play over and over Jared, on any TF or Instrument

Jared: Okayyyy, is there a name for this? Pointing to a certain part of the screen.

Warren: Yes it is an FTR.

Jared: WTF!

Warren: NO, an FTR!

Jared: WTF, WTF!

Moral of the story if it is a WTF Move, that person doesnt have a clue.

You must of seen them on forums, gasping WTF when price has hit supply or and FTB and jacks up 80 pips.

So there is a new move and it is called the WTF move

Lots of people are talking about it and it is all over the place in forums and trading rooms.

I dont know what IF thinks but i say we should avoid it at all costs.

There is no logic or structure to it.

So if you think you are seeing a WTF move, for god sake stay out the market

Regards,

Warren
